directory.label: Save folder
directory.description: Where screenshots are saved. Created if it does not exist.

filename_pattern.label: File name pattern
filename_pattern.description: strftime pattern without extension, e.g. screenshot_%Y%m%d_%H%M%S

delay.label: Delay (seconds)
delay.description: Wait this many seconds before capturing.

freeze_screen.label: Freeze screen while selecting
freeze_screen.description: Freeze the screen during region and window selection.

notify.label: Show notification
notify.description: Show a preview notification after each capture; click it to annotate.
